title: ぬいぐるみよりもずっと

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I spot Oguri Cap and Tamamo Cross in front of a store while I'm out shopping for groceries.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I'd heard of these, but… seeing them for myself really is something else.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Whoa, they're surprisingly well-made. I wonder how much did one set ya back?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Oh, Trainer… We're looking at these Umamusume plushies they're selling.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: There are Tama plushies, Creek plushies… and even ones of the president. They're all adorable.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Yeah, but Oguri is the most popular. Take a look for yourself—there's only one left in stock!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: And not just in the racing scene. She's a pretty big name in competitive eating too.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Boys, girls, grandpas, grandmas—everyone loves Oguri!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: I wanna get my hands on one of these Oguris for myself. Unlike the real thing, you don't gotta buy food for it!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: And look at its face. It's like it knows it's a fast runner. What do ya think, Trainer? Wanna add this plushie to your training roster?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Hey…

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Hah! Tempting, right?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: …Hold up. I just remembered I gotta meet up with Inari.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Gotta run. See ya!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Tamamo Cross dashes off.
choice_data_list: I think I'm going to buy this Oguri Cap plushie.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: What?! B-but why? You know it's just a plushie, right?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Even you wouldn't be able to train this thing to run.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Well… I won't stop you from buying it… If you really want one, go ahead…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: For some reason, Oguri Cap seems upset.
choice_data_list: …On second thought, maybe I don't need it.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: …Huh?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: How come you didn't buy the plushie? I thought you wanted it.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: And Tama's right—you don't have to buy a plushie food.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Wait, I pay for my own meals. That shouldn't matter either way.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: But plushies are small. And fluffy. Not to mention cute. I can't compete there.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I just… think you're better off sticking with the real deal. I can run really fast, y'know.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: What can a plushie do? It can't even move! You'd probably be better off believing in me over a stuffed toy.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: No… You'd definitely be better off. I'll outdo that plushie—just you wait.
choice_data_list: Buying a plushie is a way of showing support.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: No… You'd definitely be better off. I'll outdo that plushie—just you wait.
choice_data_list: Buying a plushie is a way of showing support.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Trust me. With you by my side, I'll become the strongest, fastest Umamusume around!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna devote all my energy to training—no matter how hard it gets.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: After all, I'm much tougher than a plushie! So please, keep laying it on me!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Oh… That makes sense. I mean, a plushie isn't something you can train up, is it?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: A way of showing support, huh? When you put it like that, it sounds kinda encouraging.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: You, and everybody else who's bought my plushie… You're all a source of my strength.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna keep on racing. You can always count on me.
